description: Control Plane runs containerized apps across AWS, GCP, Azure, Oracle Cloud, and your own hardware as one platform. Build a GitHub or a GitLab repo into a container and deploy it to a live HTTPS URL, give it a custom domain, attach Postgres or Redis, and let it autoscale. Diagnose failures from logs, metrics, and events, and find the over-provisioned workloads inflating your cloud bill.

defaultPrompt: Build this GitHub repo and deploy it, then give me the live URL
Diagnose why my workload won't start and fix it
